subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: take come give put gather see pass arrange announce encourage The boat race (a) ⎯⎯ by any club. The date (b) ⎯⎯ in due course. The spectators (c) ⎯⎯ and line up along the banks of the river in which the race (d) ⎯⎯ place. The hawkers (e) ⎯⎯ moving through the crowd selling many things. The boats (f) ⎯⎯ in a proper row. The rowers look much excited. They (g) ⎯⎯ by their supporters. The umpire and judges take their position. A great excitement (h) ⎯⎯ through the crowd. Now the zero hour (i) ⎯⎯ for the starting of the race. The starter (j) ⎯⎯ the signal. Right go the boats onward. A huge cry goes round the place.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs (a) is arranged (b) is announced (c) gather (d) takes (e) are seen (f) are put (g) are encouraged (h) passes (i) comes (j) gives
